senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. נוּחַ)to bring to rest, to lead.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20:11">Ex. R. s. 20</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 13:17">Ex. XIII, 17</cite>) <he>לא נָחָם ממצרים וכ׳</he> he did not lead them from Egypt to Palestine by the route of eleven journeys; Tanḥ.
B’shall. 1 נחם נהגם naḥam means, he led them; v. נִיחוּם.
